list.name: Exchange Listings Scanner
highlights: Default window is 7 days; dedupe is by exchange+url+title (Alpha by alphaId). Noise filter drops campaigns, copy-trade, dividends, funding/leverage tweaks. Use `--all` to see everything.
Bithumb's 5-notice API window means hourly runs are needed so nothing gets missed.
Type classifier is keyword-based (`classify()` in scan.py). Korean: 신규 거래지원/마켓 추가 = listing, 거래지원 종료 = delisting, 거래 유의 = warning (Korean "monitoring tag"), 해제 = warning lifted.

2026-10-14: added `거래지원 종료` to STRONG so Korean delisting titles that also mention 출금 일시 중단 (a NOISE term) are no longer dropped (Upbit BLAST notice 6658 was missed). Margin-only removals (e.g. Bitget "suspension of X/USDT margin") are filtered by default; check `--all` in the morning sweep. Backup of prior script: scan.py.bak (box-local, temporary).

2026-10-15: Coinbase moved official asset announcements back to X @CoinbaseAssets (id 1422537905885442055) on Oct 14; @CoinbaseMarkets (id 720487892670410753) now quote-tweets selected launches. The `x` MCP namespace (get_users_posts with start_time) reads both without login, so check them in the morning sweep (scan.py does not).

2026-10-17: KuCoin Alpha listings ("KuCoin Alpha New Listed Token") come through annType=latest-announcements, not new-listings, so scan.py missed baton (Oct 16). Check latest-announcements for "KuCoin Alpha" in the morning sweep until scan.py polls it.
